# Segmented control: `jl-segmented`

A few exclusive choices in a row, with a thumb that slides to the chosen one.

- Class `JlSegmented`, a molecule: `import { JlSegmented } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/segmented

For two to five exclusive choices that change what a view shows: a period, a layout, a density. The
thumb slides to the chosen option. Each option is { value, label?, icon?, disabled? }; an option without a label
shows its icon and its value names it for screen readers.

It is a radio group for assistive technology and takes part in forms like one: its name and value go in the form's
data, and a reset brings back the value the page gave. The arrow keys move the choice; change fires with the value
people pick.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSegmented } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSegmented
  label="Period"
  options={[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]}
  value="week"
/>
```

```html
<jl-segmented
  label="Period"
  options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'
  value="week"
></jl-segmented>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `options` (attribute `options`): `SegmentedOption<Value>[]`, default `[]`. The choices: { value, label?, icon?, badge?, disabled? }. badge is a count or a short word after the label.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `Value | ''`, default `''`. The chosen option’s value; the first option that can be chosen when it names none.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field’s name in the form’s data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The group’s name for screen readers, when no visible label names it.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height: 30, 36 or 44 pixels.
- `block` (attribute `block`): `boolean`, default `false`. Takes the whole width, the options sharing it.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed, and is left out of the form’s data.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `Value`: People chose another option; the detail is its value.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The track that holds the options and the thumb.

## Typing

Typed by its values, JlSegmented<'list' | 'grid'> takes options of those values only, and gives change and value as one of them: the editor completes them and refuses another. In JSX, the type can also be read from the options.

```ts
import type { JlSegmented } from '@syware/jlib';

type View = 'list' | 'grid';

const view = document.querySelector<JlSegmented<View>>('jl-segmented.view');
view?.options.set([
  { label: 'List', value: 'list' },
  { label: 'Grid', value: 'grid' },
]);
// @ts-expect-error: 'table' is not a view
view?.value.set('table');
view?.events.register('change', (value) => showView(value)); // value: View, not string
```

```tsx
import { Jadis } from '@jadis/core';
import { JlSegmented } from '@syware/jlib';

import type { SegmentedOption } from '@syware/jlib';

type View = 'list' | 'grid';

const VIEWS: SegmentedOption<View>[] = [
  { label: 'List', value: 'list' },
  { label: 'Grid', value: 'grid' },
];

export class OrdersToolbar extends Jadis {
  static readonly selector = 'orders-toolbar';

  templateHtml(): Node {
    // value="table" does not compile. Without <View>, the type is read from the options.
    return <JlSegmented<View> label="View" options={VIEWS} value="list" onChange={(value) => showView(value)} />;
  }
}

OrdersToolbar.register();
```

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Labels, icons, or both

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-segmented label="Period" value="week" options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'></jl-segmented>
  <jl-segmented label="View" value="grid" options='[{"value":"list","icon":"list"},{"value":"grid","icon":"layout-grid"},{"value":"board","icon":"layers"}]'></jl-segmented>
  <jl-segmented label="Theme" value="system" options='[{"value":"light","label":"Light","icon":"sun"},{"value":"dark","label":"Dark","icon":"moon"},{"value":"system","label":"System","icon":"monitor"}]'></jl-segmented>
</div>
```

### Sizes

sm in dense toolbars, md by default, lg where a thumb presses it.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-segmented size="sm" label="Period" options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'></jl-segmented>
  <jl-segmented label="Period" options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'></jl-segmented>
  <jl-segmented size="lg" label="Period" options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'></jl-segmented>
</div>
```

### Full width and disabled

block shares the whole width; an option or the whole control can be disabled.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-segmented block label="Plan" value="yearly" options='[{"value":"monthly","label":"Monthly"},{"value":"yearly","label":"Yearly"},{"value":"lifetime","label":"Lifetime","disabled":true}]'></jl-segmented>
  <jl-segmented block disabled label="Period" options='[{"value":"day","label":"Day"},{"value":"week","label":"Week"},{"value":"month","label":"Month"}]'></jl-segmented>
</div>
```

### With counts

A badge says what waits behind a choice.

```html
<jl-segmented label="Reviews" value="pending" options='[{"value":"pending","label":"To review","badge":6},{"value":"done","label":"Decided"}]'></jl-segmented>
```

### In a form

The value goes with the form; change fires as people choose.

```html
<form class="stack narrow demo-form">
  <jl-segmented name="density" label="Density" value="comfortable" options='[{"value":"compact","label":"Compact"},{"value":"comfortable","label":"Comfortable"},{"value":"spacious","label":"Spacious"}]'></jl-segmented>
  <p class="muted demo-output">density=comfortable</p>
</form>
```

```js
const form = root.querySelector('form');
const output = root.querySelector('.demo-output');
root.querySelector('jl-segmented').events.register('change', () => {
  output.textContent = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join('&');
});
```
